samples.reason: The query asks for concise synthesis of evidence from multiple sources into a single structured paragraph answering specific questions, which maps directly to summarization and extraction capabilities. Willet-235B substantially outperforms Lapwing-235B on both Summarization (86.4 vs. 80.6) and Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 vs. 79.2), and its stronger overall benchmark suite makes it the better choice for this tightly constrained, evidence-based writing task.

The query is a tightly constrained summarization and extraction task (synthesize evidence from sources into a single concise paragraph answering two specific historical questions). Willet scores meaningfully higher on Summarization (86.4 vs. 80.6), Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 vs. 79.2), and instruction following (IFEval 89.8 vs. 85.3), making it the stronger choice for adhering to the strict formatting requirements while accurately distilling source material.
